note: A paragraph and the sentences it splits into.

cases.name: a citation before the period
cases.text: Acme is in Negotiation [^f_1]. Next step: a call on Oct 15 [^f_2].
want: Next step: a call on Oct 15 [^f_2].

cases.name: a citation after the period
cases.text: Acme signed. [^f_1] Then it grew.

cases.name: a citation flush after the period
cases.text: Acme signed.[^f_1] Then it grew.

cases.name: abbreviations and initials
cases.text: BRACKWELL Inc. hired J. Doe in Oct. 2026. She left.
want: BRACKWELL Inc. hired J. Doe in Oct. 2026.

cases.name: decimals
cases.text: Usage grew 3.5 times! Why? Nobody knows

cases.name: across lines
cases.text:
Security must finish before
the board meets [^f_1]. Done.
want:
Security must finish before
the board meets [^f_1].

cases.name: a quoted end
cases.text: She said "we are in." Then left.

cases.name: a curly quoted end
cases.text: She said “we are in.” Then left.

cases.name: a period inside quotes
cases.text: Dana wrote "send it." and then called.
want: Dana wrote "send it." and then called.

cases.name: U.S. before a capital
cases.text: Acme is a U.S. Company with depots. It grew.
want: Acme is a U.S. Company with depots.

cases.name: U.S. before lowercase
cases.text: Acme has U.S. depots [^f_1]. It grew.

cases.name: a.m. and p.m. before lowercase
cases.text: The call is at 9 a.m. on 2026-11-02 [^f_4b10]. Lunch is at 1 p.m. today.
want: The call is at 9 a.m. on 2026-11-02 [^f_4b10].

cases.name: p.m. before a capital
cases.text: 3 p.m. Meeting ended.

cases.name: e.g. before a capital
cases.text: Pick a depot, e.g. Denver. Then call.

cases.name: a domain at the end
cases.text: Mail moves to stellarway.example. It took a week.

cases.name: a URL at the end
cases.text: Notes are at https://notes.example/acme. Read them.

cases.name: an ellipsis
cases.text: Wait... Then it happened.

cases.name: numbered items
cases.text: 1. First. 2. Second.

cases.name: a digit after a period
cases.text: The renewal is due Nov. 2 at the latest. Then the board meets.
want: The renewal is due Nov. 2 at the latest.

cases.name: CRLF line ends
cases.text:
Acme signed [^f_1].
It grew.

cases.name: a citation after CRLF
cases.text:
Acme signed.
[^f_1] It grew.

cases.name: Chinese and Japanese ends, which need no space
cases.text: 阿尔德三月续约[^f_1]。合同为期十年！[^f_1]他们会扩张吗？「三月に更新します。」彼女はそう言った。
